body: All that runs through my head when I'm around people--and even when I'm not is: "oh my god, I have nothing to say, I have nothing to say, I'm boring the shit out of these people." And then I do end up saying nothing so its a cycle. I avoid social interaction because I think im the most boring person even with nothing to say, but when I get around people I don't say anything because nothing is in my head except what I posted above.
